evidence.claim: Its steel-and-wood floating bridge could be detached from one bank to let boats through, then hauled back into place with lines.
evidence.quote: The bridge that spanned the river was a floating bridge, made of steel and wood. When a boat came near and wanted passage, the bridge would be unhooked from one bank and allowed to float out of the way. When the boat had passed, lines were used to haul the free end of the bridge in and reconnect it.
